regions.label: Prague
regions.note: Prague charges the full national maximum of 50 Kč per person, per night.

provenance.source_name: City of Prague local tourist fee (ordinance 18/2019, as amended 19/2021)

regions.label: Other cities and tourist towns
regions.note: Each municipality sets its own fee up to the national cap of 50 Kč per person per night; popular tourist towns like Karlovy Vary, Český Krumlov and Brno are often at or near it, so 30 is a middle estimate and the full band runs 0 to 50.

provenance.source_name: Zakon c. 565/1990 Sb., o mistnich poplatcich (e-Sbirka)

regions.label: Villages and countryside
regions.note: Many small municipalities charge no accommodation fee at all.
